title: Machine that makes drinking water from air
statement: Communities without clean water sources need drinking water. Design a machine that pulls water out of the air and delivers drinking water, running only on renewable energy.
constraints: Delivers at least 2,000 litres of drinking water per day
Runs only on renewable energy (no grid power, no fuel)
Total cost of the water, equipment and running costs together, is at most 2 US cents per litre
